scope: One-seed dense offline action diagnostic; no production speed or peak-memory advantage claim

protocol.prefix_solver: Ordinary fixed-RP PCG; shadow compression never changes its active preconditioner
protocol.learned_basis: Stream first ten p,Kp into learning.compress_probe at fixed rank
protocol.polishing: Y=K Q; W=Q.T Y; generalized Nystrom, one k-RHS block product
protocol.gaussian: Y1=K Omega; Q=qr(Y1); Y2=K Q; two k-RHS block products
protocol.actual_column_restoration: Production QR pivoting on polished factor; query every selected column
protocol.pairing: Every delayed branch starts at the identical x10 and directly recomputed residual
protocol.stopping: Original b-Ax checked every20 iterations, on suspected convergence, and at the limit
protocol.representation_comparison: Compare factor branches with factors and actual-column branches with actual columns
protocol.dense_work: K@Q is a dense offline surrogate; count block calls/RHS separately from scalar solve products
